FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(PENANG BRIDGE) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Penang Bridge) (Amendment) Order 2020.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 1 February 2020.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Penang Bridge)

Order 1995 [P.U. (A) 410/1995], which is referred to as the "principle Order" in this

Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1) by substituting for the words

"31 December 2038" the words "31 December 2058".

Substitution of Second Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the Second Schedule the

following Schedule:
